mapper.select: /*selectImResultList*/ SELECT B.REG_USER_ID , B.PO_NO AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE , B.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.RE_DESCRIPTION , DECODE(B.CH_DESCRIPTION,'★','변경사항 없음',B.CH_DESCRIPTION) AS CH_DESCRIPTION , B.RE_SPECIFICATION , DECODE(B.CH_SPECIFICATION,'★','변경사항 없음',B.CH_SPECIFICATION) AS CH_SPECIFICATION , B.RE_ORIGIN_CODE , DECODE(B.CH_ORIGIN_CODE,'★','변경사항 없음',B.CH_ORIGIN_CODE) AS CH_ORIGIN_CODE , B.RE_MAKER_CODE , DECODE(B.CH_MAKER_CODE,'★','변경사항 없음',B.CH_MAKER_CODE) AS CH_MAKER_CODE , B.RE_MAKER_NAME , DECODE(B.CH_MAKER_NAME,'★','변경사항 없음',B.CH_MAKER_NAME) AS CH_MAKER_NAME , B.RE_MAKER_PART_NO , DECODE(B.CH_MAKER_PART_NO,'★','변경사항 없음',B.CH_MAKER_PART_NO) AS CH_MAKER_PART_NO , B.RE_CMS_CATEG_ID , DECODE(B.CH_CMS_CATEG_ID,'★','변경사항 없음',B.CH_CMS_CATEG_ID) AS CH_CMS_CATEG_ID , B.BELOW_TEXT , B.CONTRACT_NO , B.CONTRACT_SEQ , B.PM_NO , B.PM_SEQ , B.QUOTATION_NO , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE B.QUOTATION_NO = CMPY.COM_CODE) AS BUYER_NAME FROM KEPMGPHD A, KEPMGPDT B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PM_NO = B.PM_NO AND A.BUYER = #{COMPANY} AND A.PM_NO = #{DOCU_NO} ORDER BY B.BUYER, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO, B.QUOTATION_NO
mapper.update: INSERT INTO IF_PROGRESS /*InsertCaImIF_PROGRESS*/ (BUYER,GUBUN,LEGACY_NO,REVISION,STATUS,IF_FLAG,REMARK,CHANGE_DATE,CHANGE_TIME) SELECT A.COMPANY , 'IM' , B.KEY_1 , '1' , 'C' , 'Z' , 'PKG_ITEM_MODIFY' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') FROM ICOGDOCU A, ICOMTRGW B WHERE A.COMPANY = #{COM_CODE} AND A.DOCU_NO = #{TARGET} AND A.COMPANY = B.COM_CODE AND A.DOCU_NO = B.TARGET AND B.DOC_NAME = 'IM' and A.PASS_STATUS = '3'
